releases.notes:
# Starlight & Delight

### Patch notes of v1.0 :
**- Adds:**
  - Cooking Table: a new crafting blocks that allows you to craft some new foods !
  - New foods:
    - Raclette
    - Quiche
    - Pastel de Nata
    - Carrot Cake
    - Kouign-Amann
    - Cinnamon Roll
    - Apple Crumble
    - Energy Beverage
    - Red Wine
    - Potato Fries
    - Golden Potato Fries
    - Hash Browns
    - Fried Chicken
    - Cooked Shrimp
  - New Ingredients:
    - Cinnamon Bark
    - Cinnamon
    - Flour
    - Dough
    - Cream
    - Butter
    - Grapes
  - New items:
    - Climber's Bandanna
    - Starlight Glasses
    - Starlight Shard
  - New Effects:
    - Satiated (granted by some of the new foods, allows you to not lose hunger for a while)
    - Zapped (applied when hit by a weapon with the Lightning Striker enchant)
  - New Mob: Shrimp
  - New Tree and Wood set: Cinnamon Tree (strip it to get cinnamon bark and then cinnamon)
  - New Bush: Grape Bush
  - Advancements to guide player progression
  - Easter Egg when naming a fox "Raclette"
  - Added compatibility with JEI and Nicos Backslot

**- Changes:**
  - Starlight Armor texture has been changed (not sure if i want to change it again or if this one will stay)
  - Hoely Beheader texture has been changed
  - Fermenter behavior has been tweaked slightly
  - Pink Garnet Door has been retextured
  - Some blocks gui model have been tweaked
  - Tweaked Starlight Pickaxe auto-smelting slightly
  - Changed Lightning Striker effect to now apply Zapped effect instead of summoning lightning bolts
  - Changed Starlight Armor and Pink Garnet Armor set bonus
  - Starlight Bow now deals more damage by firing arrows with a higher velocity
  - A bunch of other misc tweaks

releases.notes:
# Starlight & Delight

### Patch notes of v0.8 :
**- Adds:**
  - Cheese, make it by putting a milk bucket in a fermenter (more food coming soon :D)
  - Fermenter crafting block
  - Pedestal block entity, right-click it with an item to display it on top

**- Changes:**
  - Mantis are now the correct size (smol)
  - Pink Garnet and Starlight items now have custom colored names

  - **The mod name is now Starlight & Delight, removed every entry of "ChrysaorMod"**

# More Stars, Less Useless Things

### Patch notes v0.7 : 
**- Adds :**
  - Starlight Sword:
    - On right-click, summons a Light Sword that looks in the direction the player looks, on left-click with a Light Sword summoned, it launches the Light Sword which then follows where the player looks (guided missile)
  - Starlight bow (more damage than normal bow)
  - Starlight Shovel
  - Starlight Hoe:
    - Harvest/Mine an horizontal area of 3x3 if breaking hoeable blocks or crops
  - Tomahawks Items:
    - Can be thrown with right-click
    - 4 variants: Iron, Gold, Pink Garnet & Diamond
  - Mantis Mob:
    - 2 variants: orchid and normal
    - Will tweak its size later on
    - Can be bred with Cauliflower
  - Sweet Berries Pie
  - Cheese
  - (Will add more food later on)
  
**- Changes :**
  - Berserker effect now gives a red overlay on your screen
  - Starlight Pickaxe now can smelt mined blocks when sneaking
  - Hoely Beheader item now has a custom GUI texture to better fit in with the rest
  - Hoely Beheader now has better custom sweep particles 
  - Some other minor tweaks 
  
**- Removes :**
  - Removed Magic Block and Chisel Items (not fitting with what i want this mod to be)

# Starlight, Loot and Survival Friendly

### Patch notes v0.6 : 
**- Adds :**
  - Light Effect : 
    - While sneaking, you can climb up walls (like a spider)
  - Berserker Effect:
    - Same as Strength III but you have 5 hearts and your sweeping damage ratio is maxed
  - Starlight Ore and its results : 
    - Starlight Ore generates between y=-60 and y=10 and drops Starlight Ashes
    - Starlight Ashes can be put with a Nether Star to craft a new item : Starlight Fragment
    - Starlight Upgrade Smithing Template can be found in End Cities
    - Put a Starlight Smithing Template with a Netherite item and a Starlight Fragment in the Smithing Table to get the new Starlight Items
    - Starlight Items for now include : 
      - Starlight Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings and Boots
      - Starlight Axe, Pickaxe and Hammer
  - Starlight Armor : 
    - Full set gives you : Speed; Jump Boost, Luck and new Light effect
  - Hoely Beheader Item now has custom sweep particles (Thank God finally) and gives you the Berserker Effect
  - Recipes for every item
  - Cauliflower seeds can be found by breaking grass
  - Pink Garnet Horse Armor can be found in chests (Nether Fortress and Dungeon)

**- Tweaks :**
  - Hoely Beheader model
  - Pink Garnet Ore generation (should be less frequent)
  - Pink Garnet Armor full set Effect (less OP)

### EVERY ITEM IS NOW OBTAINABLE IN SURVIVAL :D !
